areas.ag: Rhode Island Dept. of Environmental Management
areas.t: An uneventful week of sunshine and mild temperatures is expected. Fine particles will be building up through Thursday with high pressure in place and limited mixing. Sunny with light west winds Tuesday. Fine particles upper GOOD. For Wednesday and Thursday, continued sun with highs in the mid 60s. F
